title: elytrigia pertenuis
intro: Elytrigia pertenuis, commonly known as Sea Wormwood or Sea Wormwood grass, is a type of perennial grass native to the coastal regions of Europe and Western Asia. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Elytrigia pertenuis include its ability to modulate the immune system, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of Elytrigia pertenuis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
